Cornucopians - In celebration of our token launch on PancakeSwap and partnership with Netvrk, we are doing another giveaway! 

Thank you for participating! The purpose of this campaign is to not only grow our community, but to spread the word of our token launch and partnership with Netvrk! A huge shout out to our partner, Netvrk who has generously donated 2 Sportster NFTs! 

By participating in this giveaway, you will be helping us by organically sharing, retweeting, and posting the content we have provided. Growing our community is critical to the success of our game and we want to reward you for being a part of it. (See giveaways below) Please note that we will not tolerate any kind of foul play. This is setup to be cheat proof, but If we see anything suspicious going on, you will immediately be removed from the server. I know you guys would never cheat anyways… right?!

How does it work?
After logging in, you will be presented with a list of actionable items that are to be executed on a variety of social platforms. For every “action” you complete, you earn 1 entry. For each entry you earn, you have a better chance of having your name drawn at the end of the challenge. If you don't feel comfortable completing a social challenge, no worries! Just move on to the next task. Once our campaign has completed, our team will schedule the live drawing. We will then randomly draw our winners and announce them live. YOU DO NOT HAVE TO BE PRESENT AT AMA TO CLAIM

IF YOU LEAVE OUR DISCORD, YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED

Winners will have 72 hrs to contact me via discord or respond to our email. Otherwise their prize will be forfeited to the next person on the list.

Please note that it is advised to login with common email providers such as google, yahoo, etc. Also, using VPNs will most likely result in being flagged as spam.
